He is widely recognized as one of the most successful and prolific players in football history. [SRC-630cf715a62e]

### Career Milestones by Club
- **Sporting CP (2002–2003):** Began his professional senior club career with 31 matches and 5 goals [SRC-ed19658c86e6].

- **Al Nassr (2023–present):** Scored over 130 goals in the Saudi Pro League. [SRC-ed19658c86e6]

### International Career
Representing the Portugal national team since 2003, Ronaldo has scored approximately 146 goals, establishing himself as the all-time leading goalscorer in men's international football history [SRC-ed19658c86e6].
Across his entire senior career, his official total stands near 980 to 981 goals. [SRC-ed19658c86e6]

### Major Awards
Ronaldo has won the prestigious Ballon d'Or five times: once with Manchester United in 2008, and four times with Real Madrid in 2013, 2014, 2016, and 2017 (with the 2013 and 2014 editions awarded under the FIFA Ballon d'Or designation) [SRC-630cf715a62e].

The distinction in award naming reflects a significant period in Ballon d’Or history.
Between 2010 and 2015, France Football and FIFA collaborated to present a combined award known as the FIFA Ballon d’Or.
Ronaldo won twice during the FIFA Ballon d’Or period, in 2013 and 2014. After the partnership ended following the 2015 edition, France Football returned to presenting the award under the Ballon d’Or name in 2016. Ronaldo won again in 2016 and 2017.
Ronaldo’s five victories span nearly a decade and two major clubs. Each came after seasons of high individual output and, in most cases, major team silverware.
